_comment: Exceptions only; most mods are matched by the mod id in their fossic thread header. Fields: id = mod_info.json id, thread = fossic thread id (thread-<id>-1-1.html). Optional rule: release = regex on a release's display name or version (threads shipping several mods), releaseIndex = position in the release list, mode = "edited" (use the thread's last edit time), version = fixed value.
